en-e1-l1.title: Alfabetu no lian dahuluk
en-e1-l1.concept: Liafuan fasil atu hanoin bainhira ó hatene ninia lian dahuluk no letra dahuluk. Lee ho lian maka'as no tuir lian sira.
en-e1-l1.example: ball → B, cat → C, dog → D

en-e1-l2.title: Hato'o kumprimentu
en-e1-l2.concept: Bainhira hasoru malu, dehan **Hello**. Bainhira sai, dehan **Goodbye**. Dehan ó-nia naran ho **My name is ...**.

en-e1-l3.title: Númeru no kór
en-e1-l3.concept: Aprende liafuan númeru hanesan one, two, three... no liafuan kór hanesan red, blue, yellow...

en-e1-l4.title: Família
en-e1-l4.concept: mother (inan), father (aman), grandmother (avó feto), baby (bebé): liafuan sira-ne'e atu bolu ema iha família.

en-e1-l5.title: Liafuan iha sala-aula
en-e1-l5.concept: desk, chair, bag, pencil, book... Koko dehan sasán iha sala-aula ho lia-inglés.

en-e2-l1.title: Naran animál no sasán
en-e2-l1.concept: Liafuan ne'ebé hatudu naran, hanesan rabbit (koelu), bird (manu) no fish (ikan), naran **substantivu**.

en-e2-l2.title: Liafuan ba asaun
en-e2-l2.concept: Liafuan ne'ebé hatudu movimentu, hanesan jump (salta), run (halai) no eat (han), naran **verbu**.

en-e2-l3.title: I like / I have
en-e2-l3.concept: **I like ...** katak 'ha'u gosta ...', no **I have ...** katak 'ha'u iha ...'.
en-e2-l3.example: I like dogs. I have a cat.

en-e2-l4.title: Halo fraze badak
en-e2-l4.concept: Hafoin I, uza **am**. Hafoin You, uza **are**. Fraze tuir orden 'sé → oinsá / halo saida'.
en-e2-l4.example: I am a student. You are kind.

en-e2-l5.title: Lee testu badak
en-e2-l5.concept: Bainhira lee, uluk buka liafuan husi pergunta iha testu laran.
en-e2-l5.example: Mina has a cat. → busa ida

en-e3-l1.title: Harii fraze
en-e3-l1.concept: Fraze tuir orden 'sé → halo → saida'. Hafoin He, She ka ema nia naran, aumenta **-s** ba verbu.

en-e3-l2.title: Pronome
en-e3-l2.concept: Iha naran nia fatin, ó bele uza **He** (nia, mane), **She** (nia, feto), **It** (nia, sasán), **They** (sira), **We** (ita).
en-e3-l2.example: Tom is tall. He is tall.

en-e3-l3.title: Prezente no pasadu
en-e3-l3.concept: Ba buat ne'ebé akontese agora ka repete, uza **prezente**. Ba buat ne'ebé akontese tiha ona, uza **pasadu**: aumenta **-ed** iha verbu nia rohan.

en-e3-l4.title: Rutina loron-loron
en-e3-l4.concept: get up, brush my teeth, eat breakfast, go to bed... Koko konta ó-nia rutina loron-loron ho lia-inglés.

en-e3-l5.title: Komprende testu
en-e3-l5.concept: Lee testu no buka sé mak halo saida, no bainhira.

en-e4-l1.title: Prezente, pasadu no futuru
en-e4-l1.concept: Ba agora ka toman, uza **prezente**. Ba pasadu, aumenta **-ed**. Ba buat ne'ebé ó sei halo, uza **will + verbu forma báziku**.
en-e4-l1.example: I will visit my aunt tomorrow.

en-e4-l2.title: Pergunta no fraze negativa
en-e4-l2.concept: Hahú pergunta ho **Do/Does**. Atu dehan lae, uza **don't/doesn't**.
en-e4-l2.example: Do you like pizza? I don't like onions.

en-e4-l3.title: Liafuan ba forma no sentimentu
en-e4-l3.concept: big (boot), small (ki'ik), hot (manas), cold (malirin): liafuan sira-ne'e deskreve oinsá buat ida haree ka sente.

en-e4-l4.title: Liafuan ba fatin
en-e4-l4.concept: Uza **on** (iha leten), **in** (iha laran), **under** (iha okos), **behind** (iha kotuk) atu dehan sasán iha ne'ebé.
en-e4-l4.example: The book is on the desk.

en-e4-l5.title: Lee testu badak
en-e4-l5.concept: Buka iha testu sé mak halo saida no iha ne'ebé, depois responde.

en-e5-l1.title: Artigu, plurál no There is/are
en-e5-l1.concept: Uza **an** antes lian vogál no **a** antes lian konsoante. Ba buat ida, uza **There is**. Ba buat barak, uza **There are**.
en-e5-l1.example: an apple, two boxes, There are three books.

en-e5-l2.title: Liafuan atu kompara
en-e5-l2.concept: Atu kompara buat rua, uza **-er + than**. Ba 'liu hotu', uza **the -est**. Ba liafuan naruk, uza **more**.

en-e5-l3.title: Ko'alia kona-ba futuru
en-e5-l3.concept: Ba buat ne'ebé ó sei halo, uza **will + verbu forma báziku** ka **be going to + verbu forma báziku**.
en-e5-l3.example: I am going to visit Jeju.

en-e5-l4.title: Hakerek fali fraze
en-e5-l4.concept: Ba fraze negativa, uza **not / don't / doesn't / didn't**. Ba pergunta, tau **Are / Do / Does** iha fraze nia hahú.
en-e5-l4.example: I am happy. → I am not happy.

en-e5-l5.title: Komprende testu
en-e5-l5.concept: Testu naruk sai fasil se ó buka sé, iha ne'ebé, bainhira no saida, hanesan ó risku sira iha okos.

en-e6-l1.title: Revee tempu verbál hotu
en-e6-l1.concept: Ba buat ne'ebé akontese agora, uza **be + -ing**. Ba pasadu, uza **tempu pasadu**. Ba futuru, uza **will / be going to**.

en-e6-l2.title: can, must, should, may
en-e6-l2.concept: **can** (bele), **must** (tenke), **should** (di'ak atu), **may** (hetan lisensa atu): hafoin sira mai verbu forma báziku.

en-e6-l3.title: Aumenta vokabuláriu
en-e6-l3.concept: Aprende hamutuk liafuan ho signifikadu besik malu no liafuan kontráriu, no ó-nia vokabuláriu sei sai dala rua.

en-e6-l4.title: Liafuan atu liga
en-e6-l4.example: I was tired, so I went to bed early.

en-e6-l5.title: Lee parágrafu
en-e6-l5.concept: Lee testu ho fraze barak no buka sé mak halo buat ruma, bainhira no tanba saida, depois responde.
en-e6-l5.example: Jina was tired because they walked a lot.

en-h1-l1.title: Tempu perfeitu no perfeitu kontínuu
en-h1-l1.concept: had + p.p. ba buat ne'ebé akontese antes eventu pasadu seluk; have been -ing ba asaun ne'ebé kontinua to'o agora.
en-h1-l1.example: I have been waiting for an hour.

en-h1-l2.title: Advérbiu relativu no orasaun substantiva
en-h1-l2.concept: where / when / why mak relativu ne'ebé servisu hanesan advérbiu; whether / that hahú orasaun substantiva.
en-h1-l2.example: This is the town where I was born.

en-h1-l3.title: Orasaun partisípiu
en-h1-l3.concept: Hasai konjunsaun no sujeitu, no troka verbu ba -ing. Sujeitu tenke hanesan iha parte rua.

en-h1-l4.title: Liafuan liga no fluxu testu nian
en-h1-l4.concept: Haketak kauza–efeitu (so, therefore), kontraste (however), ezemplu (for example) no aumentu (in addition).

en-h1-l5.title: Ideia prinsipál no prenxe espasu mamuk
en-h1-l5.concept: Ideia prinsipál dala barak iha hafoin However, ne'ebé fila hanoin komún, no iha fraze ikus. Prenxe espasu mamuk tuir fluxu problema → solusaun → rezultadu.

en-h2-l1.title: Inversaun no énfaze
en-h2-l1.concept: Bainhira Never/Hardly/Only then mai uluk, orden sai verbu auxiliár + sujeitu. Uza It is ~ that atu fó énfaze.
en-h2-l1.example: Never have I seen such a view.

en-h2-l2.title: Subjuntivu (kondisaun la reál)
en-h2-l2.concept: Iha I wish / as if / If, uza pasadu ba kontráriu husi prezente, no had p.p. ba kontráriu husi pasadu.
en-h2-l2.example: I wish I had studied harder.

en-h2-l3.title: Relativu kompostu no orasaun konsesiva
en-h2-l3.concept: whatever, whoever, whichever no however + adjetivu signifika 'saida de'it / sé de'it / ida ne'ebé de'it / maske oinsá ...'.
en-h2-l3.example: However hard it is, I will try.

en-h2-l4.title: Vokabuláriu iha kontestu
en-h2-l4.concept: Buka hatene signifikadu liafuan foun husi sinál kontraste, ezemplu no kauza, no husi ninia prefiksu.

en-h2-l5.title: Fluxu lójiku testu nian
en-h2-l5.concept: Tuir testu nia fluxu ho liafuan ne'ebé hatudu ba buat ruma no liafuan liga. Halibur detalle sira atu to'o konkluzaun.
en-h2-l5.example: In this way = ho dalan ne'e

en-h3-l1.title: Estrutura paralela no konkordánsia
en-h3-l1.concept: Parte sira ne'ebé liga ho and/but/or iha forma hanesan. Verbu tuir sujeitu prinsipál.

en-h3-l2.title: Ambiente, tonu no objetivu
en-h3-l2.concept: Hatene ambiente husi liafuan deskritivu no emosionál. Hatene objetivu se testu husu, fó informasaun ka konvense.
en-h3-l2.example: Please store enough water. → avizu (fó informasaun)

en-h3-l3.title: Orden fraze no insersaun
en-h3-l3.concept: Uza liafuan liga, liafuan hatudu no orden tempu hanesan sinál atu tau fraze sira iha orden no buka fatin ba fraze ne'ebé fó.

en-h3-l4.title: Kolokasaun no espresaun idiomátika
en-h3-l4.concept: Aprende liafuan ne'ebé la'o hamutuk, hanesan make a decision, take a risk, heavy rain, no buka hatene signifikadu espresaun idiomátika husi situasaun.
en-h3-l4.example: the last straw = problema ikus ne'ebé halo ita lakon pasiénsia

en-h3-l5.title: Kompleta rezumu
en-h3-l5.concept: Buka testu nia ideia xave no espresaun kontraste, no hamenus sira ba fraze ida de'it.
en-h3-l5.example: cost more ↔ save money in the long run

en-l1.title: Aprende liafuan loron-loron
en-l1.concept: Liafuan ne'ebé ita uza beibeik sei hela kleur iha memória se ó aprende hamutuk **lian + signifikadu + hakerek**. Hili butaun altifalante atu rona pronúnsia.
en-l1.example: library = biblioteka / desk = meza / milk = susubeen

en-l2.title: Verbu be: am / are / is
en-l2.concept: Verbu be muda forma tuir sujeitu. **I → am**, **he / she / it → is**, **you / we / they → are**.
en-l2.example: I am a student. She is my friend. They are in the classroom.

en-l3.title: Prezente husi verbu komún
en-l3.concept: Se sujeitu mak **he / she / it (tersera pesoa singulár)**, aumenta **-s / -es** ba verbu. Liafuan ne'ebé remata ho -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o simu -es; ba konsoante + y, troka y ba i no aumenta -es!
en-l3.example: go → goes / watch → watches / study → studies

en-l4.title: Plurál no harii fraze
en-l4.concept: Se substantivu iha rua ka liu, baibain aumenta **-s**; se remata ho -x, aumenta **-es**; plurál irregulár tenke hatene ho kabeen. Fraze tuir orden **sujeitu → verbu → seluk**.
en-l4.example: book → books / box → boxes / child → children

en-m2-l1.title: Present perfect (prezente perfeitu)
en-m2-l1.concept: have/has + partisípiu pasadu. Hatudu esperiénsia, buat ne'ebé remata ona ka kontinua; haketak since (momentu ida) no for (durasaun).
en-m2-l1.example: I have lived here for five years.

en-m2-l2.title: Voz pasiva
en-m2-l2.concept: Uza be + partisípiu pasadu atu dehan katak buat ruma hetan asaun. Aumenta sé mak halo ho by.
en-m2-l2.example: The room is cleaned by Mina.

en-m2-l3.title: Infinitivu ho to no jerúndiu
en-m2-l3.concept: want, hope, decide + infinitivu ho to; enjoy, finish, avoid + jerúndiu. stop + to V hatudu objetivu, no stop + V-ing katak para halo asaun ida.
en-m2-l3.example: I want to buy a bike. She enjoys singing.

en-m2-l4.title: Komparativu no superlativu
en-m2-l4.concept: -er/-est no more/most. Uza than ho komparativu no the ho superlativu. good → better → best mak irregulár.

en-m2-l5.title: Leitura: tópiku no detalle
en-m2-l5.concept: Lee uluk pergunta, depois buka fraze ne'ebé fó sinál. Títulu no ideia prinsipál kobre testu tomak.

en-m3-l1.title: Pronome relativu
en-m3-l1.concept: Liga fraze rua sai ida ho who (ema), which (sasán), that (rua hotu) no whose (na'in).
en-m3-l1.example: I have a friend who lives in Canada.

en-m3-l2.title: Fraze kondisionál no ipótese la reál
en-m3-l2.concept: If + prezente, will + V (buat ne'ebé bele akontese). If + pasadu, would + V (imajina buat ne'ebé la los agora).
en-m3-l2.example: If I were rich, I would travel.

en-m3-l3.title: Pergunta indireta
en-m3-l3.concept: Uza orden liafuan-pergunta + sujeitu + verbu. Labele uza do/does/did.
en-m3-l3.example: Do you know where he lives?

en-m3-l4.title: Partisípiu
en-m3-l4.concept: -ing mak ativu ka la'o hela; -ed mak pasivu ka remata ona. Ba sentimentu, uza -ing ba buat ne'ebé halo ita sente, no -ed ba ema ne'ebé sente.
en-m3-l4.example: an exciting game / I am excited

en-m3-l5.title: Leitura: inferénsia no objetivu testu nian
en-m3-l5.concept: Kombina sinál sira atu halo inferénsia. Deside testu nia objetivu husi ninia pedidu no opiniaun.
en-m3-l5.example: Could you tell me ...? → pergunta (husu informasaun)
